_comment: A SECOND document type generated from the same ClientLedger with no new src/ logic — proof that data (ledger) and presentation (config) are separate. This one is INTERNAL (not for the client): it shows the conflict log (which source we trusted, and why), value provenance, and every outstanding flag, i.e. it demonstrates the 'which source to trust when sources disagree' reconciliation directly. client_facing:false, so the client-report compliance checks (verbatim lines, Tax-iff-disposal, figures-must-trace-to-ledger) don't apply — an audit view deliberately shows stale/rejected values and closed accounts. Run: generate --client <name> --config config/adviser_review_config.json -> outputs/<name>__adviser_review.md

sections.title: Reconciliation Review — internal, not for client distribution
